title: About
description: About DanDan Stories and the people behind the stories.
content_html:
DanDan Stories began as a small notebook where I wrote down ordinary things I didn't want to forget.

What we write about

Everyday life, journeys, memories and short fiction - all written slowly and honestly, for readers anywhere in the world.

title: Contact
content_html: Have a story you'd like to share? Write to us at hello@dandanstories.com.

title: Privacy Policy
description: How DanDan Stories handles reader information.
content_html: This website does not collect personal information from readers beyond anonymous traffic statistics.
